verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's docs say it issues and renews free, publicly trusted certificates for all domains added to and activated on Cloudflare, and that issuance, renewal, and deployment are automatic. This covers the free, auto-renewing part of the story, but nothing in the evidence mentions wildcard coverage. missing for 10: explicit wildcard certificate coverage, Workers-specific custom-domain certificate documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Cloudflare issues — and renews — free, unshared, publicly trusted SSL certificates to all domains added to and activated on Cloudflare.
Cloudflare handles issuance, renewal, and deployment automatically.
